tools.name: postcode_summary
tools.description: FREE. Quick property snapshot for one UK postcode: median Land Registry sold price + sales count (3 years, ~800 m), flood band, crimes last month, EPC certificates, amenities within 1 km. Returns a link to buy the full report.

tools.name: postcode_report
tools.description: PAID (£2.99 one-time). Full UK Postcode Property Report: every nearby Land Registry sale with medians by property type, flood warning/alert areas and live warnings, 3-month crime trend by category, food hygiene ratings nearby, EPC bands, CQC care services, planning applications, nearest school/GP/st

tools.name: buy_report_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link (£2.99) for the full report on one postcode.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "postcode_report" references sensitive artifacts (access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
